info.description: Source foundation includes sessions, onboarding, directory, screening and account administration. Schema through019 is installed; the admin-only API is published with model inference disabled. Source and isolated checks are distinct from authenticated hosted/provider/device verification. Historical data/image cutover, trusted assignment eligibility provisioning and model/mobile release remain open. Assignment eligibility management source requires prepared migration020; hosted installation remains through019.

post.description: Requires migration 018, server-only Auth setup, global accounts.manage and current onboarding/session gates. Reserves before one Auth create; confirmed completion creates the active profile. Migration022 requires first-password change only for teacher/expert/parent; admin/researcher credentials are permanent. Optional delivery_method email requires a configured HTTPS mailer and sends once after completion. Mail failure returns the created account with separate credential_delivery metadata; it never replays Auth or email. Completed request replays return not_repeated and never trust the replay password. No automatic permission grants. Pending issuance needs operator reconciliation.

get.description: Implemented read-only directory. Server verifies current session/onboarding and repeats scope checks in one database statement. School grants permit the school directory; student administrative reads require assignments.manage within school scope. Teachers see currently assigned students, parents linked children, experts context for currently assigned screenings. No screening classifications or images are returned. Missing/inaccessible student details share 404. Lists use descending created_at/ID keysets with signed actor/session/filter/limit-bound cursors valid for 30 minutes; restarting the API invalidates cursors.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Use the returned next_cursor with the same filters and limit; expires after 30 minutes or API restart.

post.description: Implemented transactional directory mutation. SQL repeats current session/onboarding and scoped management/ownership checks. School creation requires a global schools.manage grant; edits require the current expected_revision. Teacher student creation derives teacher_id and requires current school membership; administrative assignments require assignments.manage for source/destination schools, active teacher membership and explicit candidate eligibility. Eligible parent links may be cleared with null. Teachers cannot change schools or assign another teacher. Student creation requires a durable Idempotency-Key; replay reauthorizes and returns current metadata without duplicate insert/audit. Names normalize whitespace; duplicate_name is a scoped warning and does not merge records. JSON is bounded to 8 KiB.

get.description: Existing admin/researcher school/grade candidate reads remain unchanged. With migration027, teachers may supply parent_email plus grade_level to find one existing active parent by exact normalized login email, including an account without linked students. Teacher school/grade, current session and onboarding gates are repeated in SQL. This lookup exposes only user_id, full_name and role, supports no cursor or broad directory search, and returns no match for unknown/ineligible accounts. Without parent_email, existing teacher self-discovery includes grade_levels. Teachers may link/change/remove a parent only on their own students within assigned school/grade scope; another teacher, school moves and grade-scope expansion remain forbidden.

Source requires migration020. Global accounts.manage plus assignments.manage for the selected school; SQL repeats session/onboarding/scope checks. Explicit actor/candidate pair only. Teacher actors may select eligible parents in their school; admin/researcher actors require existing school assignment authority. Teacher/expert candidates need membership. Protected actor ceilings, current candidate revision and credential-operation locks apply. Changes audit atomically; no role, permission, membership or existing record assignment is created or removed. Legacy compatibility endpoint; migration023 role-based assignment flows no longer use actor-specific eligibility to select teacher/expert candidates.
